decision: ACCEPTABLE SEPARATE REVISION WITH KNOWN REGRESSION AND FRESH CONFIRMATION DISTINGUISHED
notes: Only source changes from V1A are measured W+B error replacing W error, and absolute +/-4.5 kW correction/anti-windup replacing +/-5 kW. No healthy/counterfactual signal is added.

Recovery signed magnitude, positive-only and absolute energy ceilings tighten from 1 kJ to100 J before V2 test results. They remain a distinct engineering recovery contract, not the original exact-theory slack budget.
Pre-onset and whole-from-checkpoint ledgers explicit in pre-result addendum.
Old corners are now regression evidence. New tau4.5/5.5ms,R27/33MW/s,offset19/61us cells are fresh confirmation; neither is a uniform interval proof.
Finite physical W/B/current tolerance only; no complete controller-state recovery threshold.
